scope: Unchanged generateCurrentUVCutMesh class method with identity APDV transform, supplied normals and temporary output files. Three synthetic cases: regular cylindrical chart, curved seam/nonplanar tube, reversed face winding and seam pair order. Also unchanged tileAnnularCutMesh and interpolate2Dpts_3Dmesh helpers.
python_differences: Default interpolation retains original triangles. Explicit matlab_scattered chooses Delaunay linear interpolation. Default output winding preserves source orientation; preserve_orientation=False gives MATLAB rectilinear face order. No nearest extrapolation. Exact seam endpoint copying, adaptive mesh-mode tiling with integer phase-offset removal (fixed three tiles in matlab_scattered mode), validated periodic fields, optional supplied normals, no APDV copy or disk workflow.
delaunay_ties: Case 0 has co-circular rectangular cells. XYZ and normals are invariant to the diagonal choice, but the first non-affine field component is not. Test that both MATLAB and Python fields equal one of the two analytic piecewise-linear interpolants instead of requiring identical tie-breaking. Cases 1 and 2 compare all fields directly.
